루트 추이(기간 없음).text: a.status = 'completed' AND true AND a.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM scope_runs WHERE true) AND a.region NOT IN ($1) AND a.prompt_id IN (SELECT scope_prompt_id FROM prompts WHERE project_id = $2 AND scope_prompt_id IS NOT NULL)

루트 추이(기간).text:
a.status = 'completed' AND true AND a.run_id IN (SELECT run_id FROM scope_runs WHERE true) AND a.job_id IN (SELECT ca.job_id FROM scope_answer_cycle_anchors ca WHERE ca.round_date >= $1::date AND ca.round_date <= $2::date AND ca.view_anchor_date IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.view_anchor_date <= hmg_anchor_today() AND true AND (ca.surface = 'project' OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM summary_cycles sc
     WHERE sc.cycle_id = ca.cycle_id
       AND sc.fleet_visible
       AND sc.view_anchor_at IS NOT NULL AND sc.view_anchor_at <= now()
       AND sc.active_generation_id IS NOT NULL AND sc.hidden_reason IS NULL
  )) AND ca.is_default_engine) AND a.region NOT IN ($3) AND a.prompt_id IN (SELECT scope_prompt_id FROM prompts WHERE project_id = $4 AND scope_prompt_id IS NOT NULL)

루트 스냅샷.text:
a.status = 'completed' AND true AND a.job_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (ca.round_date, a.prompt_id, a.target, a.region) a.job_id
    FROM scope_answers a
    JOIN scope_runs r ON r.run_id = a.run_id JOIN scope_answer_cycle_anchors ca ON ca.job_id = a.job_id
    WHERE true
      AND r.status IN ('completed', 'partial_failed')
      AND a.status = 'completed' AND a.region NOT IN ($1) AND NOT (
    a.region <> 'KR'
    AND a.prompt_id IS NOT NULL
    AND a.prompt_id IN (SELECT sp.prompt_id FROM scope_prompts sp WHERE sp.is_korean)
  ) AND (
    a.prompt_id IS NULL
    OR a.prompt_id NOT IN (
      SELECT sp.prompt_id FROM scope_prompts sp
      WHERE sp.prompt_id IS NOT NULL
        AND sp.regions IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(sp.regions) > 0
    )
    OR (a.prompt_id, a.region) IN (
      SELECT sp.prompt_id, r FROM scope_prompts sp, unnest(sp.regions) AS r
      WHERE sp.prompt_id IS NOT NULL
        AND sp.regions IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(sp.regions) > 0
    )
  ) AND ca.round_date = (SELECT max(ca2.round_date) FROM scope_answer_cycle_anchors ca2 WHERE ca2.surface = 'standard' AND ca2.view_anchor_date IS NOT NULL
      AND ca2.view_anchor_date <= hmg_anchor_today() AND true AND (ca.surface = 'project' OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM summary_cycles sc
     WHERE sc.cycle_id = ca.cycle_id
       AND sc.fleet_visible
       AND sc.view_anchor_at IS NOT NULL AND sc.view_anchor_at <= now()
       AND sc.active_generation_id IS NOT NULL AND sc.hidden_reason IS NULL
  ))) AND ca.view_anchor_date IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.view_anchor_date <= hmg_anchor_today() AND true AND (ca.surface = 'project' OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM summary_cycles sc
     WHERE sc.cycle_id = ca.cycle_id
       AND sc.fleet_visible
       AND sc.view_anchor_at IS NOT NULL AND sc.view_anchor_at <= now()
       AND sc.active_generation_id IS NOT NULL AND sc.hidden_reason IS NULL
  )) AND ca.is_default_engine
    ORDER BY ca.round_date, a.prompt_id, a.target, a.region, ca.measured_at_orig DESC, a.job_id DESC
  ) AND a.prompt_id IN (SELECT scope_prompt_id FROM prompts WHERE project_id = $2 AND scope_prompt_id IS NOT NULL)
